morphology.pattern_note: 词首 ke- 是词根的一部分。首音节 e 为央元音 /ə/，后两个 e 为 /e/；词尾 /k/ 在常见马来西亚读音中实现为 [ʔ]。

word_family.gloss: 各种或多份脆片；完整重叠形式
木薯脆片；词组，无附加词缀

senses.zh_definition: 把木薯、香蕉、芋头等切成薄片后油炸制成的脆片。
senses.en_definition: Crisps made by thinly slicing and frying cassava, bananas, taro, or similar ingredients.
senses.ms_definition: Makanan daripada hirisan nipis ubi kayu, pisang, keladi atau bahan seumpamanya yang digoreng hingga rangup.
senses.nuances: 强调食材切片后制成的脆片，不专指马铃薯片。与常以淀粉混合物制成的 keropok 有别。释义据 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=kerepek) 改写。

senses.zh_definition: 某些海鱼的马来俗名；属于与食品义不同的同形词。
senses.en_definition: A vernacular name for certain marine fishes, including Heniochus acuminatus.
senses.ms_definition: Nama bagi beberapa jenis ikan laut, termasuk Heniochus acuminatus.
senses.nuances: DBP 另列 kerepek II，属于较少见的鱼名义。日常购物或饮食语境默认理解为脆片；鱼名一般加 ikan。以下为辨义搭配，不代表高频日常用语。

collocations.zh: 一种俗称 kerepek 的海鱼
collocations.en: a type of fish known as kerepek

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pengusaha tempatan itu menghasilkan kerepek pisang untuk pasaran dalam negeri.
dual_scenarios.zh: 这家本地企业生产香蕉脆片，供应国内市场。
dual_scenarios.en: The local producer makes banana chips for the domestic market.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kerepek pisang ni rangup betul lah, nak lagi sikit!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kerepek pisang ini sangat rangup. Saya mahu sedikit lagi!
dual_scenarios.zh: 这个香蕉脆片真脆，我还想吃一点！
dual_scenarios.en: These banana chips are really crunchy. I'd love a few more!
spoken_features: rangup betul 用后置 betul 加强语气
口语中省略可从语境恢复的主语

messages.speaker: Aina (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku kat kedai ni. Kau nak kerepek ubi ke kerepek pisang?
messages.ms_standard: Saya berada di kedai ini. Awak mahu kerepek ubi atau kerepek pisang?
messages.zh: 我现在在店里。你要木薯片还是香蕉片？
messages.en: I'm at the shop. Do you want cassava crisps or banana chips?

messages.speaker: Mei (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kerepek pisang lah. Beli satu pek je, kat rumah dah ada kerepek ubi.
messages.ms_standard: Saya mahu kerepek pisang. Beli satu pek sahaja kerana di rumah sudah ada kerepek ubi.
messages.zh: 香蕉片吧。买一包就好，家里已经有木薯片了。
messages.en: Banana chips, please. Just one pack—we already have cassava crisps at home.

etymology.historical_story: The supplied evidence establishes kerepek as a whole Malay word, without identifying a secure earlier source. Its everyday meaning captures a simple preparation: ingredients such as cassava or bananas are sliced thinly and fried. Remembering that process helps distinguish kerepek from keropok, rather than inventing a historical explanation from the opening syllable ke. [Dictionary reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=kerepek).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 跟着 ke-re-pek 三拍想象：切薄片、下油锅、咔嚓脆；记住它是切片炸成的零食。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 向朋友或客人分享时可说 Silakan makan kerepek（请吃脆片）；向长辈递食物时用右手较合当地礼节。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合零食、伴手礼及待客语境。购买时可具体问原料和口味；kerepek 与 keropok 不宜一概互换。
